newsitem.title: MEXICO: Kimber to propose dividend and stock split.
newsitem.headline: Kimber to propose dividend and stock split.

text.p: Mexican paper and health care company Kimberly Clark de Mexico S.A. de C.V. (Kimber) announced on Friday it will propose a dividend payment and stock split at a shareholders assembly to be held on Feb 28.
Kimber said it will propose a one-to-five stock split in a call for the assembly published in local newspapers.
The company will also propose issuing T class "working shares" to be offered exclusively to its employees.
The assembly will also discuss a dividend of 80 centavos per A, B or T class share after the stock split, equivalent to 4.00 pesos per share prior to the split, to be paid in four equal parts.
Kimber will also propose the sale of assets but gave no details. The company was not available for comment.
